Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.
Image 1 is the original HOI4 portrait and composition target. Image 2 is the user's exact 奶龙 identity reference: a smooth golden-yellow round creature with green rings around black eyes, a small horizontal mouth and creamy belly.
Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. RETAIN the original person's visible hairstyle, hairline, hair color, eyebrows, moustache, beard and sideburns as distinguishing features attached to the mascot, adapting them to its round head. Match the original's parting, thickness, curls and facial-hair shape. Preserve a bald scalp or clean-shaven face only where the original actually has one. Do not invent hair hidden under a hat.
Preserve the original clothing, uniform, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, scale, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. attempts.prompt:
EDIT ONLY THE PERSON in image 1. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait/card and the sole authority for visible features, composition, clothing and exterior. Image 2 is only the user mascot identity reference: a fictional yellow 奶龙 with a compact round head, short broad neck, solid black oval eyes with green rings and no white sclera, one small mouth at the actual original mouth position, and no human nose, ears or skin. If a moustache is present, the one mouth remains below it; never add a second gray slit or default mascot lip above the moustache.

SOURCE-VISIBLE FEATURES TO PRESERVE:
Dark navy peaked naval cap with gold eagle, gold wreath around a round cockade, gold braided chin cords, shiny black visor and gold oakleaf embroidery above the visor; hair and hairline are covered, with short grey sideburns near the ears. Dark grey eyebrows, no glasses, no moustache or beard, and a visibly clean-shaven smooth chin. Dark navy jacket with broad lapels over a white pointed shirt collar and dark tie, partial gold shoulder/epaulette detail and one black-and-white neck cross with a tiny red accent above it.
Retain the actual source hair, eyebrows, facial-hair extent, headgear, eyewear, clothing and decorations only where visibly present. Do not copy a bare scalp or missing eyebrows from the mascot reference over real source hair. Do not invent features from names or biographies.

COMPOSITION, EXPRESSION AND LIGHT:
Preserve the frontal upright head-and-upper-chest portrait, direct serious gaze, closed lips, centered cap near the top edge, broad naval lapels and shoulders clipped by the sides. Retain soft frontal illumination, under-cap shadows and restrained gold/white collar contrast.
Fit the existing collar naturally around a rounded chin and very short broad neck transition while preserving its original open/closed state. No long neck column, pinched collar, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Preserve exactly one source-appropriate mouth and expression.

BACKGROUND, FRAME AND EXTERIOR:
Real full-rectangle opaque pale warm-grey/beige photographic/painted backing: preserve the fine mottled texture, softly lit center, muted edge vignette and original brightness through every corner. It is not a transparent exterior; do not substitute a cutout, matte, new interior, halo, smoke, frame or note.

OPAQUE RGB WORKING PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
This is the authorized best-RGB pass. Source alpha will be restored separately only after actual visual RGB review, using the recorded source-alpha BILINEAR method without changing RGB. Do not request or paint a checkerboard or green screen. Keep all original opaque backing, cloth and paper solid; no interior holes, haze or see-through fabric. The tiny red neck detail, finest cap embroidery and partial shoulder insignia are not clear enough to specify further. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
attempts.external_reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the full exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; checked cap, hair, brows, clothing, collar and backing, verified parent/receipt/evidence/generation bindings, and independently recomputed RGB identity and BILINEAR source-alpha equality with read-only Python.
